m4t.label: DJI Matrice 4T
m4t.name: Matrice 4T
m4t.source: Enums and payload sub enums from Pilot 2 exports (thermal alone and the zoom camera never seen in a file). Cameras from a real Matrice 4T's images (EXIF): thermal 640x512 at 12 micrometers; wide 4032x3024, its sensor size from the 24 mm equivalent of the 6.7 mm lens (approximate). Confirmed against Pilot 2 area missions: at 14.02 m it spaced photos 1.0761 m and lines 1.35 m apart for 85% overlap, within 0.1% and 0.3% of these numbers.

m4e.label: DJI Matrice 4E
m4e.name: Matrice 4E
m4e.source: Enums from a Pilot 2 Smart 3D mission. Camera from a real Matrice 4E's images: 5280x3956, the 12.3 mm lens with a calibrated focal length of 3725 pixels (EXIF) gives the sensor size (5280 * 12.3 / 3725 by 3956 * 12.3 / 3725 mm, 4/3"). Agrees with Pilot 2's M4E area missions at 15, 50 and 100 m: the GSD it shows within 0.8%, the line spacing within 0.2%.

m3e.label: DJI Mavic 3E
m3e.name: Mavic 3E
m3e.source: Enums from DJI's WPML spec (Cloud-API-Doc 40.common-element.md, 2024-11-07) and its live Product Support page (2026-11-19). payloadSubEnumValue, undocumented by DJI, 0 as Pilot 2 writes it for a wide-only M4E or M4T mission; lens name visable as DJI's spec (Chinese) and real files write it. Camera: 4/3" 20 MP, 5280x3956 at 3.3 um (DJI spec page and launch announcement), 12.29 mm (DJI's Mavic 3M manual and FAQ for the same camera); agrees with DJI's GSD of H/37.2 cm/px. Route types: Pilot 2's manual (waypoint, area with oblique, linear, slope) and release notes (geometric, 2024-05-22); real-time terrain follow: DJI's WPML spec (realTimeFollowSurface, Mavic 3E/3T/3M only).
